About Us

Welcome to Underbelly Boulevard Soho – a vibrant and dynamic entertainment destination that has grown from the legacy of the world leading live entertainment company Underbelly. We are home to the hottest theatre, comedy, variety and cabaret, as well as a beautiful cocktail bar.
